provider.name: World Register of Marine Species
provider.organization_type: global marine taxonomy, nomenclature, accepted-name, synonym, classification, distribution, trait, specimen, image, bibliography, identifier, API, and download infrastructure
provider.description: The World Register of Marine Species is a global expert-curated register of marine organisms built on the Aphia taxonomic information system. It provides accepted and unaccepted names, Aphia identifiers, classifications, environment flags, fossil status, distributions, traits, sources, specimens, images, thematic databases, REST services, downloads, and versioned taxonomic changes.
institutional_context: WoRMS Steering Committee and taxonomic editors
Thematic registers and global marine biodiversity infrastructures

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting WoRMS and Aphia documentation, organization, governance, editors, taxonomic coverage, ranks, accepted names, synonyms, classifications, environment flags, fossil status, distributions, traits, specimens, images, bibliography, external identifiers, APIs, downloads, schemas, accounts, manuals, tutorials, editorial workflows, data quality, licenses, citations, software, standards, and related authorities.
purpose.authoritative_notice: WoRMS/Aphia, official taxonomic editors, thematic databases, original taxonomic publications, applicable nomenclatural codes, type repositories, release files, source databases, and cited authorities remain authoritative for names, acts, types, identifiers, versions, rights, and contacts.
